description: Chat/Terminal tab switching in ConversationsPrimaryView with Option+G/Alt+G keyboard shortcut, plus Model/effort pill UI at bottom-left of composer.
steps: In ConversationsPrimaryView.tsx: import TerminalChatPane from './TerminalChatPane'. Add local state `chatTerminalMode: 'chat' | 'terminal'` defaulting to 'chat'.

Add a 'Terminal' toggle button to the chat-header-actions section (alongside the existing JSON/Markdown/Delete buttons). The button label is 'Terminal' when in chat mode, 'Chat' when in terminal mode. Clicking toggles chatTerminalMode.

When chatTerminalMode === 'terminal' and selectedSession is set: render `<TerminalChatPane terminalId={selectedSession.sessionId} />` in place of the chat thread + composer section. Use `hidden` attribute pattern matching the existing `hidden={showRichChat}` pattern for the ol.chat-thread.

Register a window keydown listener (using useEffect in ConversationsPrimaryView) for Option+G / Alt+G: event.altKey && event.key === 'g' (lowercase). When fired and a session is selected, toggle chatTerminalMode. Guard with isEditableEventTarget from app/hotkeys.ts to prevent firing when typing.

Add Model/effort pill: add a `<div className='chat-model-pill'>` below the composer row but inside the .chat-composer container. Display the agent provider from a prop or from readAgentProviderPreference() (import from app/agentProviders.ts). Show: `{agentProvider} · default`. The pill is a button with aria-label='Switch model or effort' that is a no-op click for now (logs TODO) with Option+P / Alt+P shortcut noted in its title attribute.

In console-canvas-chat.css: add .chat-model-pill styles (small pill, left-aligned, muted text, border-radius: 999px, same style family as .chat-ghost-btn but smaller and left-aligned). Add a .chat-terminal-toggle class matching the .chat-ghost-btn style.

Write tests in apps/web/tests/conversation-chat-terminal.test.tsx: (a) render ConversationsPrimaryView with enabled=false, check no terminal is shown; (b) mock a selectedSession and verify the Terminal toggle button appears in the header; (c) simulate Alt+G keydown on window and verify chatTerminalMode toggles (by checking TerminalChatPane appears or the toggle button label changes).
acceptance_criteria: A Terminal/Chat toggle button exists in the chat header when a session is loaded
Pressing Alt+G toggles between chat and terminal views
Alt+G does not fire when focus is in an editable element (input/textarea)
The model pill appears at the bottom-left of the composer showing the current agent provider
All 139 existing tests continue to pass and new tests pass
findings: Implementation complete. TypeScript passes (npx tsc --noEmit). 5 new tests pass; 161 total tests pass (up from 156). Git commit blocked by macOS sandbox preventing .git/index.lock creation - same environment constraint as FEAT-001. Changes are in working tree ready to stage. Session-keyed reset for chatTerminalMode uses a ref comparison during render (the React-idiomatic pattern for derived state reset without useEffect render loops). The model pill is rendered as a child of the .chat-composer area via a separate .chat-model-row div after the ConversationComposer component, only shown in chat mode with an active session.
